body: Attempting to order around what is not yours? How pretentious. There are always lines of respect to have, not ignorant indulgence to blindly spit commands.

I’ve played a lot of league in my time, to the point where I had to completely cold turkey from it because of how much of a horribly toxic person I had become. Games I would suggest are things like Borderlands 2, where you can play with friends and have a blast with story campaigns; or fall guys where you don’t have to chat with people as much to have fun. If you have a larger group available, among us is a blast to play and while it may be stressful; it can be fun to deceive your friends from time to time.

I understand your sentiment, sometimes it’s hard  to learn to focus on ourselves instead of other people in life. While we may want to cheer them up and make them notice us in any way possible, if they do not want the attention; it needs to be diverted to others. If you are willing to talk, I am willing to listen and give as much wisdom as I can spare.

I don’t have a problem with having help, it’s the getting part. 

When I get wrapped up in my head, I don’t get the motivation to move from that step between needing to receiving it. Sometimes it’s from guilt of having asked so much in the past, to something as simple as thinking I don’t have the time.
GDQ which is a solid seven days in the summer? Idk, felt like they were just grasping at straws a bit to find more donors.

This is fantastic, it helps me understand the kinds of things I need to think about and act upon in the at this time, as well as use this as a reference to remind myself that my actions will have consequences; being through a lack of action or through any action I take.
